caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic pitcher with a wide body, a curved handle, and a spout, shown in an upright position. The body of the pitcher is colored in shades of reddish-brown with some lighter and darker highlights to indicate light reflection and depth. The handle is smoothly attached to the left side of the pitcher, arching outward and connecting at the upper and lower portions of the body. The spout is visible at the top right edge of the pitcher’s rim. The pitcher is centrally framed within a square border drawn on a beige background. In the lower right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller sketch of the pitcher, shown from the side in a more simplified form, accompanied by handwritten measurements along the edges of the box containing this smaller sketch. The overall composition centers the main pitcher and provides a technical reference in the corner.
title: Measure with Handle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
